title: Cross-platform equivalence eval record (one JSONL line)
description: A pair of platform events (one per side) to be labeled for cross-platform equivalence. Keyed by NATURAL KEYS (platform + platform_event_id + child platform_ids) so the record survives RESTART-IDENTITY pipeline rebuilds; serial DB ids are deliberately absent (semantic_event_id_at_build is informational context only, never used for resolution). Generated by services/pipeline/src/scripts/build-eval-sample.ts; consumed by services/pipeline/src/scripts/run-eval-suite.ts.

pair_id.description: md5 of the canonical natural key '<platformA>:<peidA>||<platformB>:<peidB>' with sides sorted lexicographically by (platform, platform_event_id). Orientation-free and rebuild-stable.

context.description: Everything an annotator needs inline + the pipeline's verdict AS OF BUILD TIME (the suite recomputes live).

cosine_distance.description: Event-embedding cosine distance at build time. CONTEXT ONLY — a known embedding-corruption bug (audit 2026-06-10 F9) makes some distances meaningless (e.g. an Oscars event 0.015 from an ETH candle). Never label from the distance.

anchor_market_pairs.description: For cross_ref_seed records: the specific market pairs proven identical by on-chain conditionId (market_cross_refs). a_/b_ refer to record sides.

llm_reasoning.description: First 280 chars of the Stage-3b LLM reasoning, if the pair was a candidate. Do NOT trust it when labeling — it is the system under test.

semantic_event_id_at_build.description: Serial id, informational only; reassigned by rebuilds — never resolved against.

shared_question_count.description: Number of questions holding >=1 market from each side at build time.

label.description: Primary 5-class label (see README for definitions and decision procedure). null = not yet labeled; the suite skips such rows.

failure_modes.description: Sublabels explaining WHY a pair is not equivalent (apply to any non-equivalent label on a same-real-world-event pair; empty for equivalent and for unrelated).

label_source.description: 'market_cross_refs' for seed auto-positives; 'human:<initials>' for annotations; 'llm:<model>' only if an LLM second annotator is used (must be reported as such).

annotator2_label.description: Independent second annotation, only on kappa_subset rows. Filled blind. Kept verbatim after adjudication.

kappa_subset.description: True for the deterministic 150-row double-annotation subset.

platform_event_id.description: Platform-native event id (natural key half). E.g. 'kalshi:event:KXEPL1H-26MAY13MCICRY' or a Polymarket numeric event id.

child_markets.description: Up to 6 child markets (ordered by platform_id) — both labeling context and the natural-key fallback the suite uses to re-resolve the event after platform_event_id format drift.
